name: Greed
shortDescription: Vusi learns that wanting everything for himself can have uncomfortable consequences after he secretly bites into the family’s fruit.
longDescription: Grandmother returns from the market with a basket full of delicious fruit. Vusi cannot resist and secretly takes bites from the fruit, but the evidence soon gives him away. After confessing, he learns a memorable lesson about greed, honesty, waiting his turn and sharing fairly with others.
